ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: a long grief
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: After a death, someone who loved the dead grieves: days of the empty place, then remembering out loud or in a dream, then small good things again, until it eases.

plain.li: {LOST}'s things are still where {LOST} left them. I can't bring myself to move them.
Set out a bowl for {LOST} at supper without thinking. Put it back before anyone saw.
Everything here is the same, except {LOST} isn't in it.
[night] Couldn't sleep. Kept listening for {LOST}'s voice in the next room.
[child] Everyone keeps being nice to me. I want {LOST} back.

warm.li: I miss {LOST}. I'm writing it down because I can't say it out loud yet.

blunt.li: {LOST} is dead. I'm still here. Getting up anyway.

cheerful.li: I keep remembering the jokes {LOST} used to make. They don't make me laugh yet. They will.

gloomy.li: It doesn't feel real. {LOST} was here, and now there's a space the shape of {LOST}.

cold.li: {LOST} is gone. I am functioning. I would prefer not to look at that more closely.

chronicle.li: Since {LOST} died, {PAWN_nameDef} eats little and is the last to go to bed.
{PAWN_nameDef} has taken the loss of {LOST} hard.

li.label: remembering
li.waiting: Next: {PAWN_nameDef} talks about {LOST} with someone, or dreams of {LOST}.

plain.li: Started to tell a story about {LOST} today and got halfway before I had to stop.
I'd like to talk about {LOST} with someone who knew {LOST}. {OTHER_nameDef}, maybe.
Nearly dreamt of {LOST} last night. I woke before I could say anything.

warm.li: {LOST} would hate all this moping. I can hear {LOST} saying so. I'm trying.

blunt.li: Need to talk about {LOST}. Not yet. Soon.

cheerful.li: Found {LOST}'s initials carved into the doorframe and laughed out loud before I could stop myself.

gloomy.li: Some hours now I forget, and then I remember all over again.

cold.li: I have started to remember {LOST} on purpose, in order. It is better than being ambushed by it.

chronicle.li: {LOST}'s name is back in {PAWN_nameDef}'s talk, though {PAWN_pronoun} can't yet get all the way through a story.

li.label: small things again
li.waiting: Next: a run of better days.

plain.li: Ate a good meal today and noticed it was good. I hadn't noticed anything in a while.
Worked all morning without thinking of {LOST} once, felt bad about it, and then less bad.
Talked about {LOST} until late. Mostly the daft things, the ones I'd half forgotten.

warm.li: Someone remembered things about {LOST} that I'd forgotten. I wrote them down so I won't again.

cheerful.li: The sun came out and I stood in it. {LOST} would have done the same.

gloomy.li: Some days it's lighter. Today was one. Tomorrow might not be.

cold.li: The loss of {LOST} intrudes less on the working day. Progress, of a kind.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I talked about {LOST} today. Neither of us had said the name aloud in days.

chronicle.li: At supper the other night, {PAWN_nameDef} laughed, and didn't stop {PAWN_objective}self.

plain.li: I can say {LOST}'s name now without my throat closing. I said it at supper today, on purpose.
Went to sit where we used to sit, {LOST} and me. Told {LOST} about the colony. I'll go again, but not every day.
I still miss {LOST}. I can get through a day now, though, and most of the evening.

warm.li: {LOST} would be glad I'm all right. I am all right. Mostly.

cheerful.li: Told one of {LOST}'s stories at supper and the table laughed in all the right places. {LOST} would have loved that.

gloomy.li: The grief's eased. I'm not sure I wanted it to. It felt like the last of {LOST}.

cold.li: The worst of it is over. I can work. I can sleep. I remember {LOST} accurately, and that will do.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef}'s grief for {LOST} has eased. It has not gone.
{PAWN_nameDef} sleeps through most nights again, and talks about {LOST} in the daytime.

plain.li: [timeout] It hasn't eased. I've just got used to carrying it.
[otherdead] Now {OTHER_nameDef} too. I don't know where to put this one.
[otherleft] {OTHER_nameDef} has gone, and {OTHER_nameDef} was the one I talked to about {LOST}.
Some griefs don't ease. This one hasn't, yet.

warm.li: [timeout] I still miss {LOST} every day. I'm learning to carry it more gently.

cheerful.li: [timeout] Some days are still hard, but I can say {LOST}'s name now and smile.

gloomy.li: [timeout] The grief isn't going anywhere. Neither am I.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} never stopped missing {LOST}. I'd like to think they're together now.
{OTHER_nameDef} grieved {LOST} right up to the end. Now I'm grieving both of them.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: a secret told
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: Someone carrying a secret tells a close friend first, finds the nerve over a few steady days, and then tells everyone, with whatever follows when a secret comes out.

li.label: the weight of it
li.waiting: Next: {PAWN_nameDef} decides whom to tell first.

plain.li: There's something I've never told anyone here. Some days it sits lighter than others. Not today.
Somebody asked about my life before the colony. I changed the subject. I'm good at changing the subject.
[goodsecret] I did something once that I've never told anyone about. Not because I'm ashamed. Because it wasn't about me.

warm.li: I've been carrying this a long time. I'd like to set it down, if I could find the courage.

blunt.li: Got a secret. Everyone does. Mine's heavier.

cheerful.li: They all think they know me here, and they mostly do!

gloomy.li: If they knew what I've kept from them, they'd look at me differently. I'm sure of it.

cold.li: I keep one matter private. It has served me. I am less sure it still does.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has had something on {PAWN_possessive} mind for days, and changes the subject when anyone gets near it.
{PAWN_nameDef} has been quieter than usual at supper, and up later than usual at night.

plain.li: I'm going to tell {OTHER_nameDef}. Just {OTHER_nameDef}, to start. If I can say it to one person, maybe I can say it to the rest.
Walked past {OTHER_nameDef} three times today, meaning to talk, and didn't.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is the one person here I'd trust with it. I'll tell {OTHER_objective} soon.

cheerful.li: I've decided to tell {OTHER_nameDef} my big secret! Now I just have to do it.

gloomy.li: If I tell {OTHER_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} turns away, I'll know what the rest will do.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is the safest first listener. I'll judge the reaction there.

chronicle.li: Twice now, {PAWN_nameDef} has found a moment alone with {OTHER_nameDef} and let it pass.

li.label: finding the courage
li.waiting: Next: a few steady days, and the nerve to tell everyone.

plain.li: Told {OTHER_nameDef}. All of it. {OTHER_nameDef} listened to the end and then asked if that was all. I laughed until I nearly cried.
{OTHER_nameDef} knows now. {OTHER_nameDef} thinks I should tell the others. I think {OTHER_pronoun} might be right.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} held my hand while I told it. I didn't know I needed that.

blunt.li: Told {OTHER_nameDef}. Didn't fall apart. Next, everyone.

cheerful.li: I told {OTHER_nameDef} and the sky didn't fall. Next, everyone else. Maybe.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} took it well. The others won't all be {OTHER_nameDef}.

cold.li: The first disclosure went acceptably. The second will be harder to control.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told me something tonight that I'll keep for as long as {OTHER_pronoun} needs me to.
I know {OTHER_nameDef}'s secret now. It doesn't change a thing about how I see {OTHER_objective}.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} confided in {OTHER_nameDef}.

plain.li: I told them. I just said it, to whoever was there, and then I went back to work, because what else do you do.
It's out, and I'm the one who said it. Whatever they think, at least they heard it from me.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} knew already, and that made it possible to say it to the rest.

blunt.li: Said it. Done. They can think what they like.

cheerful.li: Well, that's out. I feel lighter than I have in years!

gloomy.li: They know now. I don't know yet what it will cost me. I'm glad anyway.

cold.li: I have made the disclosure. The consequences are no longer hypothetical, which I prefer.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has told the rest of them. I know what that cost {OTHER_objective}.

chronicle.li: Before anyone else could tell it for {PAWN_objective}, {PAWN_nameDef} told {PAWN_possessive} secret in {PAWN_possessive} own words.
With {OTHER_nameDef} behind {PAWN_objective}, {PAWN_nameDef} stopped keeping {PAWN_possessive} secret.

plain.li: [cameout] It came out before I could say it myself. That's the part I mind most.
[timeout] I've decided to keep it to myself after all. Some things stay buried.
[otherdead] {OTHER_nameDef} was the only one who knew. Now it's mine alone again.
[otherleft] {OTHER_nameDef} has gone. I'm not ready to tell anyone else.
Not yet. Maybe never. I'll carry it a while longer.

warm.li: [timeout] I'm not ready to tell everyone. {OTHER_nameDef} understands, I think.

cheerful.li: [timeout] The secret stays put. It's kept this long; it can keep a while longer.

gloomy.li: [timeout] I lost my nerve. The secret's heavier than ever.

cold.li: [timeout] I've decided the secret serves me better kept.

fizzleChronicle.li: [cameout] {PAWN_nameDef}'s secret came out before {PAWN_nameDef} was ready to tell it.
{PAWN_nameDef} has decided to keep {PAWN_possessive} secret a while longer.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was going to tell everyone, in {OTHER_possessive} own time. {OTHER_nameDef} ran out of time.
I'm the only one who knows what {OTHER_nameDef} was carrying. {OTHER_nameDef} was nearly ready to put it down.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: a fear faced
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: Someone hurt by an enemy who got away, or haunted by a dread, trains until they're ready and stands firm in the next fight at home (or sees the enemy brought down).

li.label: the fear
li.waiting: Next: a few days for {PAWN_nameDef} to steady.

plain.li: [nemesis] I still see {NAME} when I close my eyes. The one who put me in the dirt and walked away.
[nemesis] Every raid, I look for {NAME}'s face first. I don't know what I'd do if I saw it.
[quirk] The others say there's nothing to be afraid of. Knowing that has never once helped.
[fear] My hands shake when I think about the next fight. I keep them in my pockets.
I'm tired of being afraid. I'm also afraid.

warm.li: I don't want to be afraid any more. I want to be someone the others can lean on.

blunt.li: [nemesis] {NAME}. If I see {NAME} again, I'm not running.

cheerful.li: Being afraid is very boring. I'd like to stop now, please.

gloomy.li: The fear has moved in. It sleeps where I sleep.

cold.li: [nemesis] {NAME} took something from me in that fight. I intend to take it back.
Fear is a flaw. I am correcting it.

chronicle.li: [nemesis] {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't been the same since {NAME} left {PAWN_objective} in the dirt.
Fear has a hold on {PAWN_nameDef}, and {PAWN_pronoun} is sick of it.

plain.li: Practiced until my arms ached. If the fear comes, at least my hands will know what to do.
Went out past the fields at dusk and stood there until the fear passed. It took a while. It passed.

warm.li: I'm getting ready, for the others as much as for me.

cheerful.li: I've been practicing! The target is losing badly.

gloomy.li: All the practice in the world won't help if I freeze.

cold.li: Preparation is the cure for fear. I am preparing.

chronicle.li: Every morning now, {PAWN_nameDef} is out training before the others are up.

li.label: standing firm
li.waiting: Next: a fight at home, and {PAWN_nameDef} standing firm in it.

plain.li: I'm as ready as I'll be. Next time the alarm goes up, I'll be on the wall, not under the bed.
[nemesis] Let {NAME} come back. I'll be waiting this time.

warm.li: Whatever comes next, I'll face it with the others. That's the part that helps.

cheerful.li: Ready for anything! Well, most things.

gloomy.li: I'll stand my ground next time, or I'll know I can't. Either way I'll know.

cold.li: The next engagement will settle the matter.

chronicle.li: "Next time, I'm not running," {PAWN_nameDef} says, to anyone who asks.

plain.li: The fight came, and I stood. My hands shook the whole time. I stood anyway.
[nemesis] {NAME} is finished with me, and I'm still here. I said it out loud to be sure.
[quirk] I've stopped being afraid of it. I can't explain it, and I'm not going to try.

warm.li: I held my place. The others saw. I think it helped them too.

cheerful.li: I was brave. Actually brave, not pretending!

gloomy.li: I faced it. I'll be afraid again someday, but not of this.

cold.li: The fear has been tested and found wanting.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} faced what {PAWN_pronoun} feared, and came through it standing.
[nemesis] {NAME} has no hold on {PAWN_nameDef} now.

plain.li: [timeout] The fight I was ready for never came. The fear's still here, waiting with me.
The fear won this time. Next time, maybe.

warm.li: [timeout] I'm still afraid. The others say that's all right, and I'm trying to believe them.

cheerful.li: [timeout] The fear's still here, but so am I, and I'm a lot better with a weapon now.

gloomy.li: [timeout] I trained for nothing. The fear just waited me out.

fizzleChronicle.li: [timeout] {PAWN_nameDef} was ready for a fight that never came.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was afraid, and went out anyway. I'll remember that before I remember anything else.
{OTHER_nameDef} was getting ready to face it. {OTHER_nameDef} never got the chance to find out {OTHER_pronoun} could.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: the recurring dream
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: The same strange dream keeps coming back. Told to someone, it gives an idea: make it real with one's own hands, and see if it lets go.

plain.li: [strange] Dreamt of the house with no doors again. I know every room of it now.
[nightmare] The same dream, again. The dark water, the voice under it. I woke with my heart going.
[lostdream] The place I grew up again, with everyone missing from it. Same as last time. Same as the time before.
Same dream as the last two nights. I'm starting to think it wants something from me.

warm.li: The dream came back. It isn't frightening, exactly. It feels like being called.

cheerful.li: Had my favorite strange dream again, the one with the tall birds. I'm getting fond of them!

gloomy.li: I dread sleeping now. I know what's waiting.

cold.li: The recurrence is odd. I am recording the details.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} keeps having the same dream.
[nightmare] {PAWN_nameDef} has been waking from the same nightmare, night after night.

li.label: telling someone
li.waiting: Next: {PAWN_nameDef} tells someone about the dream.

plain.li: It came again, clearer this time. I could draw it. I'll have to tell someone before it drives me mad.
I can't shake it. Even awake, I half see the dream from the corner of my eye.

warm.li: I want to tell someone about the dream. Saying it out loud might loosen its grip.

blunt.li: Need to talk about this dream with someone. Feels stupid. Doing it anyway.

cheerful.li: The dream came back again, and this time I'm telling people about it whether they like it or not.

gloomy.li: The dream again. I'm tired. I'm so tired.

cold.li: I will describe the dream to someone else. An outside view may be useful.

chronicle.li: The dream came back again. {PAWN_nameDef} spent the next morning half in it.

li.label: making something of it
li.waiting: Next: {PAWN_nameDef} makes something of the dream ({SKILL}).

plain.li: Talked the dream over, and an idea came out of it: if I make it, really make it, with my own hands, maybe it will let me go.
I'm going to make the dream into something real, through {SKILL}. Then it can stop.
[arcskill:Artistic] I'm going to carve the dream. The house, the water, all of it, in stone if I can get the stone.
[arcskill:Plants] I'm going to plant the garden from my dream, in the corner by the wall, with the rows the way they were.
[arcskill:Construction] I'm going to build the doorway from my dream. Just a doorway, standing by itself, opening onto the field.
[arcskill:Crafting] There's a box in the dream, plain wood with a brass catch. I'm going to make it, and see what it wants to hold.

warm.li: Saying the dream out loud helped. Now I want to give it a shape the others can see.

blunt.li: Making the dream into a thing. Then sleeping.

cheerful.li: I'm going to make my dream real, with {SKILL}. I've already started scratching it out in the dirt.

gloomy.li: Maybe if I make it, it will leave me alone. It's worth a try.

cold.li: Giving the image a physical form may end the recurrence. I'll test that.

chronicle.li: With {PAWN_possessive} own hands, {PAWN_nameDef} means to make the dream real, and see if it lets go.

plain.li: Haven't had the dream since I finished. Slept straight through, both nights. I'd forgotten what that was like.
I made it. It's not exactly the dream, but it's close enough that the dream seems satisfied.

warm.li: The dream has gone quiet. I almost miss it, the way you miss a strange guest.

cheerful.li: No dream last night, and I slept like a stone!

gloomy.li: The dream's stopped. I keep waiting for it to come back.

cold.li: The recurrence has ceased. Hypothesis confirmed.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef}'s dream has stopped coming.
{PAWN_nameDef} made something of {PAWN_possessive} dream, and the dream let {PAWN_objective} be.

plain.li: [timeout] I tried to make the dream into something. It wouldn't come right, and the dream keeps coming.
The dream's still there. I've learned to live with it.

warm.li: [timeout] The dream still comes. I've started telling it to a friend in the mornings, and that helps.

blunt.li: [timeout] Same dream. Couldn't make it real. Leave it.

cheerful.li: [timeout] The dream keeps coming back. At least it's never boring.

gloomy.li: [timeout] I tried to give the dream what it wanted. It still won't leave.

cold.li: [timeout] The dream persists. I've stopped trying to interpret it.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told me about a dream {OTHER_pronoun} kept having. I hope wherever {OTHER_pronoun} is, it's a good one.
{OTHER_nameDef} was making something from a dream. I'm going to keep it, finished or not.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: a grudge laid down
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: Weeks into a vendetta, someone tired of carrying it talks it over and, over some calmer days, lays it down without the satisfaction of revenge. If the enemy's banners come back first, the anger does too.

li.label: the old anger
li.waiting: Next: a few days to think it over.

plain.li: Weeks since {LOST}, and I still check my weapon every night with {FACTION} in mind.
[taken] {FACTION} took {LOST} from us. I've been waiting for them to come back so I can make them pay.
Woke up angry again. I'm always angry now. It's tiring.

warm.li: {LOST} wouldn't want me like this. I know that. Knowing doesn't stop it.

cheerful.li: I used to laugh a lot, before {FACTION}. I'd like to again.

gloomy.li: The anger is the last thing I have of {LOST}. I'm afraid to let go of it.

cold.li: My account with {FACTION} remains open. It is, I admit, expensive to keep open.

chronicle.li: Weeks on, {PAWN_nameDef} still can't hear {FACTION} named without {PAWN_possessive} jaw setting. It has been that way since {LOST}.

li.label: a friend's word
li.waiting: Next: {PAWN_nameDef} talks it over with someone.

plain.li: Thought about {LOST} all day. Not the end of it, but the ordinary days before.
I'd like to talk to someone about the grudge. Whether it's worth what it costs me.

warm.li: I'm tired of hating. Maybe someone can help me put it down.

blunt.li: Need to talk to someone. About {FACTION}. About {LOST}.

cheerful.li: I've decided to try being less angry. Starting tomorrow. Probably.

gloomy.li: I'm not sure who I am without the grudge. I might find out.

cold.li: I am weighing what the vendetta costs against what it gives. The figures are poor.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has started asking what the grudge is for, and has not liked the answers.

plain.li: We talked about {LOST} and the grudge. No one told me to forgive. I was only asked what I want my days to be for.
Let the anger out on the woodpile this morning. Split enough for a week. Felt better after.

warm.li: I said {LOST}'s name today without wanting to break something. That's new.

cheerful.li: I caught myself whistling. I haven't whistled since we lost {LOST}.

gloomy.li: The anger's cooling. I feel guilty about that, as if I'm forgetting.

cold.li: I think of {FACTION} less often. Their claim on my attention was overstated.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef}'s anger at {FACTION} is cooling, slowly, the way a hearthstone does.

plain.li: I've let it go. Not for {FACTION}'s sake. For mine, and for {LOST}, who would want better for me than this.
If I meet {FACTION} at our walls again, I'll fight them because they're there, not because of {LOST}. It matters to me that those are different.

warm.li: I thought about {LOST} all evening and didn't think about revenge once.

blunt.li: Done with the grudge. {LOST} wouldn't want it.

cheerful.li: I feel like I've put down a sack of rocks! My shoulders don't know what to do with themselves.

gloomy.li: The vendetta's over. {LOST} is still gone. I can miss {LOST} now, instead of hating.

cold.li: I have closed my account with {FACTION}. Unpaid, and closed.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has laid down {PAWN_possessive} vendetta against {FACTION}, unpaid.
{PAWN_nameDef} has let go of {PAWN_possessive} grudge over {LOST}, and can say the name now without making a fist.

plain.li: [anger] They came back. {FACTION}, at our walls again. The anger came straight back with them.
[settled] It's over, and not the way I was walking toward. The account with {FACTION} is closed. I don't know yet what I feel about {LOST}.
[timeout] I tried to let it go. It won't be let go.
The grudge stays. Maybe it always will.

warm.li: [timeout] I wanted to put it down. I couldn't, not yet.

cheerful.li: [timeout] I'm still cross with {FACTION}, but less cross than I was.

gloomy.li: [timeout] The grudge against {FACTION} has its claws in deep.

fizzleChronicle.li: [anger] {FACTION} came back, and {PAWN_nameDef}'s anger came back with them.
[settled] {PAWN_nameDef}'s vendetta against {FACTION} ended some other way before {PAWN_pronoun} could lay it down.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} had nearly let go of the grudge over {LOST}. I hope {OTHER_pronoun} found some peace at the end.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: within reach
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: Halfway to a life goal, someone starts to doubt they'll ever get there, until a friend tells them to keep going, and they do.

li.label: doubt
li.waiting: Next: someone tells {PAWN_nameDef} to keep going.

plain.li: I've been trying to {GOAL} for so long. Some days I think I'll never get there.
Halfway there, and the second half looks longer than the first.

warm.li: I want to {GOAL}. I'm starting to wonder if wanting is enough.

cheerful.li: Halfway there! Only the other half to go.

gloomy.li: Maybe I was a fool to think I could {GOAL}.

cold.li: Progress toward my goal has slowed. I am reassessing.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} set out to {GOAL}, got halfway, and has started to doubt {PAWN_pronoun}'ll ever finish.

plain.li: Talked it over with {OTHER_nameDef}, and was told, flat out, not to give up. So I won't.
Counted up how far I've come. It's further than I thought.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} believes I'll get there. That carried me through today.

cheerful.li: Back at it. {OTHER_nameDef} says I'm nearly there, and I've decided to believe {OTHER_objective}.

gloomy.li: Everyone says I'll get there. I'll believe it when I do.

cold.li: Encouragement received. Resuming work.

chronicle.li: A friend's word, and {PAWN_nameDef} is back at it.

plain.li: I did it. {OTHER_nameDef} told me to keep going, and {OTHER_nameDef} was right, and I'm going to say so.
Done. All those days of doubting, and here I am.

warm.li: I did it. I keep thinking about the push I was given, and how close I came to not listening.

cheerful.li: I did it! I've told three people already, and I'm not finished telling.

gloomy.li: I made it. I keep waiting for the catch.

cold.li: Objective achieved. The doubt was an inefficiency.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} kept going when {PAWN_pronoun} wanted to stop, and got there.

plain.li: [goalgone] I've given up on that goal. Something else matters more now.
[timeout] Still not there. Still trying, some days.
I've stopped counting how far there is to go.

warm.li: [timeout] I haven't given up. I've just slowed down.

cheerful.li: [timeout] Still a long way to go, but I've got a long way in me!

gloomy.li: [timeout] The goal keeps moving further off. Or I keep getting slower.

cold.li: [timeout] Progress has stalled. I'll reassess what's worth the effort.

fizzleChronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has stopped pushing toward {PAWN_possessive} life goal.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was so close. {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL}, and nearly did.
